## IceCube, the Upgrade and Gen2 {#icecube-future}

**IceCube:** an operating observatory and a long data record.

**Upgrade:** new instrumentation and calibration capabilities.

**Gen2:** a proposed expansion of the observatory.

## KM3NeT: ARCA and ORCA {#km3net-arca-orca}

Multi-PMT optical modules in the Mediterranean Sea.

**ARCA:** high-energy neutrino astronomy.

**ORCA:** a denser array for atmospheric-neutrino oscillation physics.

::: {.notes}
Use a common-scale comparison and an optical-module cutaway. Date the
installed configuration separately from the design configuration.

Source: [Spiering, section 3.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.26436).
:::

## Baikal-GVD and B-HUNT {#baikal-and-b-hunt}

Baikal-GVD combines modular growth with operation in fresh water.

B-HUNT explores a much larger observatory, building on experience and prototypes.

## TRIDENT, HUNT and NEON {#chinese-projects}

**TRIDENT:** a deep-sea design with hybrid photon-detection modules.

**HUNT:** a large-volume concept, including work with the Baikal programme.

**NEON:** a proposed observatory in the South China Sea.

::: {.media-caption}
[TRIDENT design](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41550-023-02087-6) ·
[HUNT proposal](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1493037/contributions/6590960/) ·
[NEON proposal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.05122)
:::

::: {.notes}
Compare scientific objectives and technology choices. Simulated sensitivities
must remain labelled projections. HUNT is the same programme introduced in
the B-HUNT discussion, not an additional independent capacity to sum.
